newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle market at standstill - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle market at standstill - USDA.

text.p: Trade was quiet, with no sales slaughter steers or heifers confirmed, USDA said.

Inquiry and demand light. Sales confirmed for the week to date on 6300 cattle, mostly previously contracted or formulated cattle. The last established price 68.00 Friday, March 7. Tuesday bids 65.00-66.00, asking 69.00-70.00.
Confirmed - none last week - 1,100 last year - none
Wk to date - 6,300 last week - 6,100 last year - 4,300
